title: Manual public-body review: five new Hebrew Igrot Kodesh letters, three Hayom Yom enrichments and nine original-language rechecks
source_body_inspection_method: Public web search was used only to discover candidate item URLs. Direct public item pages were opened and the Hebrew body lines recorded for all five new letters and nine Hayom Yom rechecks. Search snippets were not used as content. No crawler, authenticated endpoint, access-control bypass, scan-only verification or full-text copying was used.

fallback_source_results.note: Five item-level Hebrew letter bodies opened; each has a distinct AID and Evidence Family. The embedded telegram in AID 5413465 remains part of the same published letter record.
Nine original-language daily entries re-opened; three existing identities enriched in place. Same-page English renderings were not counted as independent witnesses.

deduplication_check.note: Exact-AID repository searches returned no matches, and the reviewed batch files 090–097 plus the batch-095 audit contain none of the five new AIDs. The full public-search-index file is too large for direct connector retrieval; the reconciliation workflow must perform the canonical corpus-wide duplicate check before metrics are accepted.

limitations: Seven candidate pages did not expose readable item-level Hebrew bodies and were excluded; no access-control bypass was attempted.

The same-page English presentations of Hayom Yom were not treated as independent witnesses.

AIDs 5413082 and 5412970 have proxy/secretariat-style closing formulas; no personal autograph is claimed.
AID 5413119 is a historical personal response that explicitly refers the recipient to physicians; it is not medical guidance for current use.
note: Content work is measured by inspected source text and answer-ready propositions, not by Actions success. Twenty-six candidate pages did not expose readable item-level bodies and were excluded; fallback public bodies were inspected in the same run. No Verified promotion was made.

records.title: אגרות קודש — מכתב ח׳שלג
response_propositions: המענה מסביר שחינוך אינו מתחיל ממצב ריק: לכל אדם יש תכנים מושרשים בנפש עוד לפני תחילת החינוך, שמקורם בפנימיות הנפש; החינוך עשוי לכסות עליהם לזמן מסוים, אך אינו משנה את עצם קיומם.
הערך מציין כי הופעה חד־פעמית או שיחה חינוכית קצרה עשויה לחולל שינוי עיקרי כאשר היא מסירה את הכיסוי מעל מה שכבר קיים בפנימיות הנפש.
במענה לפונה שהתרשמה מתוכן ששמעה במשך שני ערבים, המכתב מציג את ההתרשמות כראיה לכך שאמונה יכולה להיות מכוסה בשכבות חיצוניות, ומברך על הסרתן ועל החזרה למקורות.
